case_study_packaging.readiness_notes: Client, objective, quantified $1.18M savings, timing metrics, and multiple proof-points are all documented, enabling a strong, data-backed case study.
case_study_packaging.headline: Dermatology platform captures $1.18 million in annual savings and 6× ROI through Treya’s strategic sourcing program
case_study_packaging.client_problem_statement: Adult & Pediatric Dermatology, PC (APDerm), the largest physician-led dermatology network in New England, had expanded to 40+ clinics through rapid acquisitions that left purchasing highly fragmented. Site managers negotiated their own deals, creating hundreds of disparate contracts, limited spend visibility, and rising costs amid COVID-era inflation. Backed by Waud Capital Partners, APDerm needed measurable cost reductions to boost EBITDA and hit aggressive value-creation milestones without disrupting patient care.
case_study_packaging.client_problem_anonymized: A multi-site dermatology network had expanded to 40+ clinics through rapid acquisitions that left purchasing highly fragmented. Site managers negotiated their own deals, creating hundreds of disparate contracts, limited spend visibility, and rising costs amid COVID-era inflation. Supported by their PE backer and focused on operational efficiency and margin improvement, the organization needed measurable cost reductions without disrupting patient care.
approach_summary: Analyzed more than $6.3 million of indirect and clinical-support spend across 12 categories to establish baselines and savings hypotheses.
Leveraged healthcare GPO relationships to transition medical-supply distribution to McKesson and align with HPG/Premier Tier-2 pricing, cutting costs by 27 %.

Ran competitive RFPs that consolidated courier, janitorial, and telecom services from dozens of vendors to a core group of high-performers, securing up to 38 % rate reductions while maintaining service levels for 30+ clinics.
Renegotiated the incumbent Athenahealth revenue-cycle contract, lowering collection fees from 1.80 % to 1.50 % and unlocking $260K in annual savings.
Delivered quick-win GPO programs for UPS small-parcel shipping and Randstad temporary labor within 60 days, then instituted centralized contracting and quarterly business reviews to sustain results.
case_study_packaging.value_delivered_blurb: Treya verified $1,179,965 in annual run-rate savings—well above the $928K high-end estimate and more than triple the contractual savings guarantee. Six categories are already live and delivering $862K, with the remaining $318K in final contracting. Beyond the 6.2× return on Treya’s fixed $190K fee, the engagement instituted centralized contracts, 12-month price holds on core medical items, and new supplier-performance dashboards that position the client for ongoing margin expansion.
where_we_were_unique: Generated first hard-dollar savings within 60 days by activating GPO quick-wins.
Deep healthcare sourcing expertise and distributor relationships enabled 27 % savings on core medical supplies without changing formularies.
Hands-on, vendor-facing approach relieved internal staff and maintained clinician buy-in during transitions across 30+ locations.
Expanded scope mid-engagement, uncovering an additional $320K in savings opportunities beyond the original seven categories.
